id.instruksi: Dua tahap perjalanan batuan tertukar tempat. Tukar keduanya supaya urut.
id.s-darisedimen: Siklus lengkap, mulai dari dasar laut
id.darisedimen-endap: pengendapan: lumpur mengendap di dasar laut
id.darisedimen-timbun: penimbunan: lapisan memadat jadi batuan sedimen
id.darisedimen-beku: pembekuan: magma mendingin jadi batuan beku
id.darisedimen-erosi: pelapukan dan erosi memecah batuan beku
id.darisedimen-endaplagi: butirannya mengendap lagi di dasar laut
id.s-daribeku: Siklus lengkap, mulai dari batuan beku
id.daribeku-timbun: tertimbun dan memadat menjadi batuan sedimen
id.daribeku-metamorf: panas dan tekanan mengubahnya jadi batuan metamorf
id.kuarsit-kuarsit: terkubur dalam, panas dan tekanan mengubahnya jadi kuarsit
id.kuarsit-leleh: terdorong makin dalam dan meleleh jadi magma
id.kuarsit-beku: magma naik dan membeku menjadi batuan beku
id.s-candi: Dari lava ke batu pasir muara
id.candi-beku: lava gunung api membeku menjadi andesit
id.candi-timbun: tertimbun dan memadat menjadi batu pasir
id.sabak-timbun: lumpur tertimbun dan memadat menjadi batu lempung
id.sabak-metamorf: panas dan tekanan mengubahnya menjadi batu sabak
id.sabak-leleh: batu sabak terkubur sangat dalam lalu meleleh jadi magma
id.s-marmer: Marmer yang kembali jadi batu kapur
id.marmer-angkat: marmer terangkat ke permukaan saat pegunungan terbentuk
id.marmer-timbun: butiran mengendap dan memadat menjadi batu kapur
id.bawahlaut-seret: basalt terseret masuk ke bawah kerak bumi
id.pasirhitam-beku: lava dari gunung api membeku menjadi basalt
id.pasirhitam-timbun: tertimbun dan memadat menjadi batu pasir hitam
id.konglomerat-lapuk: granit di tebing lapuk oleh hujan
id.konglomerat-endap: kerikil dan pasir mengendap di dasar sungai
id.lipatan-kapur: batu kapur terjepit saat lempeng bumi bertabrakan

en.instruksi: Two stages of the rock's journey have swapped places. Swap them back into order.
en.s-darisedimen: The full cycle, starting on the sea floor
en.darisedimen-endap: deposition: mud settles on the sea floor
en.darisedimen-timbun: burial: the layers harden into sedimentary rock
en.darisedimen-metamorf: metamorphism: heat and pressure change it
en.darisedimen-leleh: melting: the rock melts into magma
en.darisedimen-beku: cooling: the magma cools into igneous rock
en.darisedimen-erosi: weathering and erosion break up the igneous rock
en.darisedimen-endaplagi: the grains settle on the sea floor again
en.s-daribeku: The full cycle, starting from igneous rock
en.daribeku-erosi: weathering and erosion break it up
en.daribeku-endap: the grains settle at the bottom of a lake
en.daribeku-timbun: they are buried and harden into sedimentary rock
en.daribeku-metamorf: heat and pressure turn it into metamorphic rock
en.daribeku-leleh: the rock melts back into magma
en.kuarsit-kuarsit: buried deep, heat and pressure turn it into quartzite
en.kuarsit-leleh: pushed even deeper, it melts into magma
en.kuarsit-beku: the magma rises and cools into igneous rock
en.candi-lapuk: rain and heat weather the andesite
en.candi-erosi: the pieces are carried by the river
en.candi-endap: the grains settle in the estuary
en.candi-timbun: they are buried and harden into sandstone
en.sabak-endap: mud settles at the bottom of a lake
en.sabak-timbun: the mud is buried and hardens into mudstone
en.sabak-metamorf: heat and pressure change it into slate
en.sabak-leleh: the slate is buried very deep and melts into magma
en.sabak-beku: the magma cools slowly into granite
en.s-marmer: Marble that turns back into limestone
en.marmer-angkat: marble is lifted to the surface as mountains form
en.marmer-erosi: the grains are carried by rivers to the sea
en.marmer-timbun: the grains settle and harden into limestone
en.bawahlaut-magma: magma comes out on the sea floor
en.bawahlaut-beku: the lava quickly cools into basalt
en.bawahlaut-seret: the basalt is dragged down under Earth's crust
en.bawahlaut-leleh: the basalt melts back into magma
en.pasirhitam-beku: lava from a volcano cools into basalt
en.pasirhitam-erosi: waves and rain wear away the basalt
en.pasirhitam-pantai: the black grains are carried to the beach
en.pasirhitam-endap: the black sand settles in layers
en.pasirhitam-timbun: it is buried and hardens into black sandstone
en.konglomerat-lapuk: granite on a cliff is weathered by rain
en.konglomerat-erosi: the granite pieces are carried by the current
en.konglomerat-endap: gravel and sand settle on the riverbed
en.konglomerat-timbun: the sediment is buried and packed down
en.konglomerat-batu: it becomes conglomerate, a pebbly sedimentary rock
en.lipatan-kapur: limestone is squeezed as Earth's plates collide
en.lipatan-tekan: it is heated and pressed hard
en.lipatan-angkat: the marble is pushed up into mountains
en.lipatan-erosi: the marble weathers and wears away
